single_goal: Distinguish visual-context memorization from sample-limited physics auxiliary learning without tuning the frozen model family.

hypotheses.A: High-dimensional visual features provide a train-root/context identification shortcut.
hypotheses.B: The physics and intervention-effect auxiliary itself needs more independent contexts than a single 18-context task provides.

joint_novisual.input: exact corresponding Base 17-D sequence plus 54-D condition; no RGB, visual feature, PCA visual representation or context ID
joint_novisual.architecture: authoritative JointIEFeasibility with Physics-GRU hidden64 and H8x13 trajectory target
joint_novisual.initialization: same authoritative per-seed pretrained Physics-GRU checkpoint as Visual Joint
joint_novisual.ie_target: SmoothL1 of predicted adjacent-force trajectory difference against the true normalized matched trajectory difference

evaluation.primary_probability: raw mean of three per-seed sigmoid probabilities for frozen full-data checkpoints
evaluation.train_root_cv: 3 folds, hold out two complete roots/six contexts/60 branches, fold-local normalization, frozen seed0 to match existing taskwise CV
evaluation.task6_single_dev_rule: Report metrics but do not claim multi-context generalization from one DEV root; rely primarily on TRAIN root-heldout CV.

pooled.evaluation: within-task held-out roots, reported separately by task; never unseen-task generalization
pooled.primary_clean_comparison: matched Pooled Joint-NoVisual minus matched Pooled Base using the authoritative H8x13/target-matched-IE formulation
pooled.original_pooled_visual_pipeline: reportable only with CRITICAL_IMPLEMENTATION_CONFOUND because its architecture, target and IE loss differ

classification_rules.Case_A: Joint-NoVisual >= Base and Visual Joint << Full across multiple tasks: VISUAL_CONDITIONING_IS_PRIMARY_CONTEXT_MEMORIZATION_PATH
classification_rules.Case_B: single-task Joint-NoVisual << Base and Visual Joint << Full, but pooled Joint-NoVisual recovers/exceeds Base: JOINT_REQUIRES_GREATER_CONTEXT_DIVERSITY
classification_rules.Case_C: single-task and pooled Joint-NoVisual remain worse: OLD_JOINT_GAIN_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER_TO_CURRENT_DATA_REGIME
classification_rules.Case_D: Joint-NoVisual consistently > Base while pooled/visual Joint remains unstable: PHYSICS_AUXILIARY_SIGNAL_SURVIVES_WITHOUT_VISUAL_CONTEXT

data_too_small_rule: DATA_TOO_SMALL may be asserted only if pooled higher-context Joint-NoVisual recovers, or a frozen nested-context diagnostic shows systematic held-out improvement with independent-context count. Otherwise use SMALL_CONTEXT_COUNT_IS_A_PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNPROVEN_EXPLANATION.
task1_label_caveat: 140/180 TRAIN labels reconstructed; analyze separately from task5, which has 180/180 direct labels.
forbidden: using DEV or TEST for selection
counting timesteps or executions as independent contexts
describing pooled training as unseen-task generalization

preexisting_artifact_handling.task0_joint_novisual: Checkpoint/result existed before this protocol; retain as retrospective evidence only after code/hash audit, with no tuning or selection.
preexisting_artifact_handling.old_nested_context_partial: Partial checkpoints existed before this protocol; retain only complete frozen settings and correct taskwise evaluator reporting before use.
